The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet Run Sight from Indonesia
Run Sight supports visually impaired individuals in engaging in sports more safely and independently.

This smart wearable detects lanes and obstacles in real time, guiding users through sound and vibration to support confident movement.

By combining empathy and innovation, Run Sight highlights new possibilities for inclusion in athletics.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution inspires movement for all.

 #SolveAmbassador #SolveForTomorrow #TogetherForTomorrow #Samsung
